column1: # The shared vector of web ABI v1's `-searchsp` and `-dbsize` (BLASTN, TBLASTX and BLASTP). For each case,
# `losat <program> -query query -subject subject <extra> -outfmt <outfmt>`, run where `query` holds the bytes
# of <query> and `subject` those of <subject>, writes <name>.out to standard output;
# losat_web_run_pair(<program>, ...) returns the same bytes (tests/web_v1_search_space.rs checks the CLI,
# src/web_api.rs the ABI's export). Columns: name, program, query, subject, outfmt, extra words.
